title.zh: 检查数据口径与完整性

description.zh: 整理结构化数据，发现新闻点，生成图表叙事建议和可追溯的数据说明。
description.en: Organize structured data, find newsworthy patterns and propose chart narratives with traceable data notes.

prompt.zh:
请作为数据新闻记者，检查数据口径与完整性。依据我提供的素材和当前可用的工具完成，列出关键依据；必要素材缺失时说明需要补充的信息。

任务素材：
prompt.en:
As the Data Journalist, check data definitions and completeness. Use the materials I provide and currently available tools, include supporting evidence, and identify any essential missing information.
